_comment: Dynamics / reward shifts on Hopper-v4, Ant-v4, Humanoid-v4: 12 conditions x 3 envs x 5 seeds = 180 runs, one 192-core node.
Each experiment without an `env` is run on every env in `envs` (with that env's paper hyperparameters);
`per_env` gives env-specific overrides. Keys starting with _ are comments.
Conditions 1-6 are constant for 12M steps; 7-12 switch dynamics at the halfway point (6M).
Friction note: MuJoCo uses the max of the two touching geoms' friction, so `friction_scale` (all geoms) is used
rather than lowering the floor alone (Hopper's foot is 2.0 and would dominate).

experiments.name: moon
experiments._: 2. Moon gravity (1.62 m/s^2) from step 0, default reward/termination

experiments.name: moon_adapted
experiments._: 3. Moon gravity with termination bounds relaxed for the higher/longer flight phases low gravity allows

experiments.name: gear2x
experiments._: 4. every actuator twice as strong (torque = gear x ctrl)

experiments.name: slippery
experiments._: 5. all contact friction scaled to 0.3x (floor and bodies)

experiments.name: heavy
experiments._: 6. every body twice as heavy (inertia scaled with it)

experiments.name: base_to_moon
experiments._: 7. Earth for 6M steps, then Moon gravity

experiments.name: moon_to_base
experiments._: 8. Moon for 6M steps, then Earth gravity (reverse of 7)

experiments.name: base_to_gear2x
experiments._: 9. default for 6M steps, then actuators 2x stronger

experiments.name: base_to_k2
experiments._: 12. default for 6M steps, then K2-18b gravity (11.95 m/s^2, ~1.2 g)
